result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export so its entry names come from the configured aspect names. I haven't run it or any tests. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl reports compile`), but I didn't try a renamed aspect.

The change is in `reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `exportJson()`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. Instead it goes through the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each, it builds the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that writes the loose text files, so the zip entry names match them by construction. With the default config the names and order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the zip no longer fails on a missing file, `git-history.zip` is written again when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` alone. It also hard-codes `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and the other names (lines 280–284). It looks like a separate code path, but it would likely miss the renamed file too, so say if you want it changed.
